title: `shareable` — a row shared beyond its org: org / subtree / user grantees, write shares, revoke, gated by `allow share on X`
note: `with shareable` unfolds to the share aggregate, its events, `GranteeIsMe` / `SharedWithMe` and the row rules.  No `test e2e` block and no wire golden: a grantee must be a REAL registry org id carried as the tenancy claim, which a literal `as { … }` claim cannot name.  The runtime proof — each grantee kind, a write share, revoke, no re-share, a Subtree grant re-targeted by an authored move, a mask still applying, the share gate's 403 — is the booted `tenancy-org-context*` leg of tenancy-e2e (`assertShareable`).

apiCaller.e2eLess: RUNTIME HOME IS TENANCY-E2E (`shareable`).  A grantee is a REAL registry org id carried as the tenancy claim, and a Subtree grant is a statement about principals in different parts of the tree — the literal `as { … }` claims of a `test e2e` block cannot name either.  The booted `tenancy-org-context*` leg (`assertShareable`) drives every surface on five backends: the share gate's 403, each grantee kind, write shares, revoke, no re-share, an authored move, a mask, a soft delete.
